levels.label: Repeatable individual workflows
levels.requirement: a separate repeat with a reusable method

levels.label: Connected intelligence environment
levels.requirement: a handoff between capabilities with persistent context

levels.label: Governed human–agent organization
levels.requirement: a reviewed decision with an owner, boundary and evaluation

levels.label: Continuously improving intelligence system
levels.requirement: comparable before/after results and a reviewed change

domains.human-expertise: Record a decision, its alternatives and the human judgment that settled it.
domains.agent-expertise: Give one agent a bounded job with an input, deliverable and rejection example.
domains.knowledge-context: Save a source note with an owner, origin and retrieval exercise.
domains.compute-economics: Record provider, authorized access method, units, currency and accepted outcomes for one run.
domains.engineering-execution: Rebuild an artifact from a clean checkout and record the command and result.
domains.research-quality: Trace a claim to an exact source excerpt and record one disconfirming observation.
domains.creative-production: Produce a reviewable original artifact and document the rights of its inputs.
domains.commercial-execution: Tie a customer observation to a falsifiable offer experiment and a decision date.
domains.governance-security: Record the permitted data boundary, budget and approving owner for one mission.
domains.organizational-learning: Teach a second operator the workflow and inspect their independent outcome.
domains.founder-independence: Hand a mission to another operator and record every founder intervention.
